notes.title: MotionRec - Steam Next Fest Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]We're excited to release a demo for MotionRec, set to launch in 2025, for Steam Next Fest! The demo is scheduled to run for a week starting June 10 and if you enjoyed it, don't forget to wishlist! [/p][p][/p][p]In the demo, play through the first couple stages of the game while getting a feel of the "record" and "playback" mechanics. You'll have to think outside of the box for some of the stages, so get creative with your recordings and playbacks and have fun! (You may even need to use trial and error) [/p][p][/p][p]If you notice any issues with the demo, please report them in the pinned thread on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2602230/discussions/"]Steam forums[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to seeing everyone's feedback!  Note: The demo will only be available during Steam Next Fest.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: Demo save data cannot be carried over to the full game. notes.title: MotionRec to be Released in 2025!
notes.notes:
PLAYISM is proud to announce that we will be publishing MotionRec, the recording puzzle action game by HANDSUM, and that it's slated for a Steam release in 2025!

[previewyoutube=fOFq4tvtHRI;full][/previewyoutube]
We also have a new trailer to introduce the game, so please check it out!

With the power to record and play back your actions, Rec will explore a desolate world while solving puzzles to proceed. Please wishlist the game and look forward to further announcements!

What's more, MotionRec will have a playable demo to be shown at PAX East in Boston from May 8 to May 11. We'll also be giving out free casette tape-shaped acrylic key chains to anyone who plays the demo at the PLAYISM booth, so please stop by if you have the chance!

Please also check out the game's new [url=https://playism.com/game/motionrec/]PLAYISM page[/url]!
